  • Classes in edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.enums used by edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller
    Class
    Description
    AllocationVisibility
    Who may see a recruitment's TA/ULA allocations (issue #224).
    ApplicationStatus
    Whether applications are currently being accepted for a recruitment.
    ClassLevel
    Graduate program level, asked of TA applicants only.
    CourseInterest
    How interested an applicant is in a course other than their first or second choice.
    EnrollmentEstimateSource
    Which UCSB API figure to copy into every course's enrollment estimate (issue #175).
    LanguageExamStatus
    The TA language exam question, with the answers the legacy form offered, in its order: exempt as a U.S. citizen, passed as a U.S. permanent resident, passed on an F1 or J1 visa, or not passed.
    OtherCampusJob
    Whether a ULA applicant will hold another UC job in the same quarter; asked so the hiring paperwork can be planned, never used to decide the application.
    RecruitmentType
    Whether a recruitment is for TA positions (grad students) or ULA positions (undergrads).
    ResidencyStatus
    Asked of TA applicants only; it determines whether a language exam applies.
    StudentStatus
    Whether a BS/MS applicant will be an undergraduate or a graduate student in the quarter applied for; ULA positions are funded for undergraduates only.
    TrainingCommitment
    A first-time ULA applicant's answer to the mandatory training commitment statement.
